A Saturday Decrypt weekend note reported Volkswagen's Wolfsburg Atlas pilot holding at Friday's roughly 99 units on the body-shop welding-jig material-handoff task across the weekend cadence consistent with the prior weekend cadence the program has carried, with the humanoid league-table OEM-adopter roster holding at Friday's nine entrants — Renault Group Cleon's 25-unit pilot commitment from Friday now sitting as a settled prior-day signing — and no fresh weekend OEM signing expected against the standard business-quiet Saturday cadence. A Saturday Standard Bots weekend note reported Hyundai Metaplant's Dangjin rolling-mill cycle-time improvement holding near Friday's 5.3 percent for a twelfth consecutive within-band day across the weekend hold, with the policy-distillation pipeline behind the cycle-time gains continuing to run on the Tenstorrent Galaxy plus Unsloth router-only stack and now executing the canonical three-paper conformance reference run on every policy-update cycle.

bullets.body: A Saturday arxiv release (2605.08234) closed the business-week research cycle with a weekend workshop-and-consolidation note that bundles the three-paper applied-deployment-plus-operator-side compliance reference set into a single end-to-end measurement-and-verification companion as the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle settles its weekend snapshot. The paper, positioned as a workshop-style consolidation companion rather than a fresh formal model, applies the now-canonical three-paper reference (Wednesday's 2605.07891 consolidation survey plus Thursday's 2605.08019 applied-deployment evaluation companion plus Friday's 2605.08147 operator-side compliance-monitoring evaluation companion) to the federal-civilian directive's first full weekend operating window under compliance-monitoring mode, and reports the eleven-operator sample's per-operator attestation-event arithmetic holding inside the consolidation survey's predicted bounds for a fourth consecutive cross-section sample. A Saturday Simon Willison weekend reading characterized the paper as the canonical pre-Memorial-Day end-of-week settling artifact for the loader-verification line, observing that the timing — released into the first weekend operating day of the compliance-monitoring phase and against a now-cleared eight-of-eight FMRB classified-annex backdrop — completes the now-eight-document reference set the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle can cite as a single coherent academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring-plus-workshop-consolidation end-to-end reference heading into the post-Memorial-Day business resumption. A Saturday andrew.ooo weekend reading observed the workshop-consolidation companion extends the existing DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated reference-implementation index by a workshop-style measurement-and-verification overlay covering the eleven-operator sample, giving the framework cohort a directly citable end-to-end measurement-and-verification artifact alongside the prior three deployment-line papers.
